# Valid { #anylumino.Valid }

```python
Valid(
    value=False,
    description='',
    readout='',
)
```

Boolean validity indicator control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                            | Default   |
|-------------|----------|----------------------------------------|-----------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `False` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control. | `''` |
| readout | optional | Whether to show the current value. | `''` |

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.Valid.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
| [placeholder](#anylumino.Valid.placeholder) | A trait for unicode strings. |
